_doc: Hand-maintained rules. Per-zone hours come from city data; this file holds what the data does not: meter holidays, rates, and district hours used as a cross-check. Update last_checked when you re-verify against source_url.

holidays_not_enforced.note: City lists the holiday itself; it does not say whether observed weekday shifts apply, so none are applied.

rates.on_street: $2/hr for hours 1-2, $3 hr 3, $3.50 hr 4, $4 hr 5, $4.50 hr 6, $5/hr hours 7-10; 10-hour max session ($39)

districts.description: Several streets between I-35 and Chicon Street
